entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. Can I start with your full name and order number, please?
Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling that up now... I see an order for a VeloFit Performance Jersey placed about a month ago. How can I help you with that today?
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's the wrong size. It's way too tight. It's useless to me.
I understand, getting the right fit is crucial. Just one moment while I check our return eligibility for you.

Alright, Sarah, thank you for your patience. I can see your order was delivered 27 days ago. Our policy for standard items like this jersey allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window.
I can go ahead and process this for you. Would you prefer a full refund back to your original payment method, or would you like to do an exchange for a different size?
Whatever. Just do the exchange, I guess. I need a large.

Of course. I've just initiated the exchange for you. I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid return shipping label. Just package the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll ship out the size large to you immediately. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No. I'll wait for the email.
Great. You should see that in your inbox within the next five minutes. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
